reconcile.note: The Geneva Bible annotators restrict Jesus's ban on judging to censorious private condemnation, leaving civil and corrective judgment commanded elsewhere untouched.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells's Skeptic's Annotated Bible treats Matthew 7:1 and Leviticus 19:15 as flatly opposed commands on whether believers may judge one another.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (2013), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (2013).

sides.snippet: in righteousness shall you judge your neighbor.
sides.verseText: \"'You shall do no injustice in judgment: you shall not be partial to the poor, nor show favoritism to the great; but in righteousness shall you judge your neighbor.

sides.snippet: Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.
sides.verseText: \"Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.
